_doc: Retail packaging of every catalog item. Each parody brand copies the packaging language of its real prototype (market study in docs/packaging.md). 'kind' = box construction (Blender, tools/blender/kit/packaging.py); 'art' = brand template texture (GPT Image, assets/tex/pack/<art>.jpg); the product name is printed over the template's label area; 'tint' takes the item's own colours (keycap colourway, switch stem colour).

case_box.desc: rigid two-piece box (lid over base), foam insert, the case in a dust bag

kraft_box.desc: brown corrugated mailer (tuck-front), black logo stamp + sticker label

plate_sleeve.desc: thin white flat box with a sticker label, plate inside in bubble wrap

esd_pcb.desc: silver ESD bag with a label inside a thin white box

keycap_box.desc: long white rigid box, lid with the set label, two vacuum-formed trays inside

switch_box.desc: small printed carton (35 pcs), tuck lid, plastic tube/tray inside

switch_bag.desc: zip-lock bag of switches with a colour sticker (boutique switches)

stab_pack.desc: clamshell or small box with stabilizer sets, card insert

jar.desc: small white jar with a printed label (lube)

poly_bag.desc: clear bag with a header card (films, foam, tape)

art.keychorn: Keychorn (Keychron): matte black rigid box, thin white line drawing of the keyboard from above, small white logo, model name bottom-left
art.kdbfans: KDBfans (KBDfans): brown kraft mailer, black stamped logo, white sticker label with model and colour
art.novelkays: NovelKays (NovelKeys): white box, big bold model name, playful blue/pink accent shapes, small NK monogram
art.modsonet: Mod (Mode Designs): deep charcoal soft-touch box, embossed tone-on-tone logo, thin gold line
art.ramma: Ramma (Rama Works): off-white box, ultra-minimal grey typography, large model number, small R mark
art.kelovna: Kelovna (Glorious/Kelowna wood): kraft box with a wood-grain band and a forest-green label
art.acrylic: generic acrylic case: white box with a clear window strip and simple black text
art.gnk: GNK (GMK): white rigid box, GNK wordmark top-left, a printed set label (render strip of the colourway) along the lid
art.eptb: ePTB (ePBT): white box with blue-black ePTB wordmark and a thin coloured stripe
art.sp: SP (Signature Plastics): plain white box, red SP oval logo, profile name
art.kat: KAT/MT3/XDA (Keyreative / Drop): black box with a coloured set illustration band
art.cherri: Cherri (Cherry MX): white carton, black wordmark, a band in the switch colour, 'MX' large
art.gateran: Gateran (Gateron): yellow and black carton, switch photo window, pin count
art.akco: Akco (Akko): pastel illustrated carton with the switch drawn large, colour of the stem
art.boutique: boutique switch zip bag sticker: round colourful label with the switch name and spring weight
art.stab: stabilizer pack: black card insert with a simple wordmark (Durok / TK / Cherri)
art.kritoks: lube jar label: white with a red/orange band and '205g0'
art.pcb_label: PCB box label: white thin box, sticker with the board name and an ESD symbol
art.plate_label: plate box label: white thin box, sticker with plate material and layout
